{{Quote|Yeah, some law, isn't it? The law that protects the rich and strong&mdash;your kind&mdash;and kills anyone who tries to do anything about it!|Suzu, to Leia Organa|<ref name="SW88" />}}
'''Suzu''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]] who was a major leader of a lower-class revolution that toppled the [[Herdessan Guild]]'s rule over her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. A fiery freedom fighter who deeply detested the decadent [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] who comprised Herdessa's ruling class, Suzu and her lover [[Finn (Herdessan)|Finn]] were present when an [[Alliance of Free Planets]] delegation arrived on Herdessa to negotiate formal diplomatic relations, and threw a ball of mud that hit Alliance leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in the face.<ref name="SW88" />

For that Suzu and Finn were hunted by [[Herdessan shocktrooper|Herdessan security services]] led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Lumiya]]&mdash;Finn was captured, and Suzu was only spared a similar fate at Organa's direct intervention. Organa followed Suzu back to the rebellion's hideout, where Suzu educated her on her people's plight and won her to their cause. Suzu and Organa then led the fighting force to topple the Guild in a daring raid on a slave transaction with remnants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], rescuing a number of [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] including Finn and Alliance diplomat [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="SW88" />
